correctness.rationale: For A,B in six-dimensional upper-triangular T3(Fq), direct multiplication yields x=αs−γp, z=βu−δr and y=(α+β)t−(γ+δ)h+pu−sr, with q² free diagonal shifts. Two independent Fq² determinant fibers each have D(0)=q(q²+q−1), D(c≠0)=q(q²−1). Most bases admit q solutions for t,h; on α+β=γ+δ=0 count prescribed pairwise determinants separately. For (x,z)≠(0,0), exceptional corrections cancel; when (x,z)=(0,0), the y=0/nonzero exception yields two fiber levels. Substitution gives precisely the four q^5 polynomial levels and strata 1,q−1,2q(q−1),q(q−1)². Independently enumerated all q^12 pairs for q=2,3, obtaining q=2 histogram {928:1,672:1,480:4,288:2}, q=3 {33777:1,27216:2,21384:12,15552:12}; weighted totals 4096 and 531441. Finite checks corroborate field-uniform determinant-fiber proof.
residual_risks: All q prime powers rely on symbolic fiber count; independent complete brute force only for q=2,3.
No statement for group commutators, or T_n with n≥4.
